claim_summary: For the Euclidean unit ball and standard FCC root lattice D3, the original common-frame Kuhn-packet radius equals the ordinary lattice covering radius 1. Exactly 24 unordered independent triples minimize the packet radius; all are full lattice bases with root squared norms 2 and pairwise inner-product multiset {-1,-1,0}. This claim is restricted to FCC and excludes the separately known BCC result.
integrity: Analytic proof covers all independent FCC lattice frames; exact-rational code independently corroborates bounded cases. No external expert or Lean attestation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only Euclidean standard FCC D3 in dimension three. BCC previously covered and excluded; possible older equivalent FCC frame enumeration remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp FCC Kuhn-packet radius and all 24 minimizing frames
